def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

    thr = 6 if c in (c0,c1) else 3

def solve5(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g) for row in g for v in set(row) if v!=0}
    mk=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==mk]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    S=set(pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def runlen(ms, i):
        # length of maximal consecutive run containing ms[i]
        a=b=i
        while a>0 and ms[a-1]==ms[a]-1: a-=1
        while b+1<len(ms) and ms[b+1]==ms[b]+1: b+=1
        return b-a+1
    def process(fixed,horiz,perim):
        ms=sorted([p[1] if horiz else p[0] for p in pts if (p[0]==fixed if horiz else p[1]==fixed)])
        if not ms: return
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(ms,ms[1:])):
            gap=b-a-1
            if gap<1: continue
            ok = gap<=6 if perim else (gap<=6 and runlen(ms,i)>=2 and runlen(ms,i+1)>=2)
            if ok:
                for x in range(a+1,b):
                    rr,cc=(fixed,x) if horiz else (x,fixed); out[rr][cc]=2
        if perim:
            lo,hi=(c0,c1) if horiz else (r0,r1)
            for m,edge in ((ms[0],lo),(ms[-1],hi)):
                if m<edge and edge-m<=6:
                    for x in range(m+1,edge+1):
                        rr,cc=(fixed,x) if horiz else (x,fixed); out[rr][cc]=2
                if edge<m and m-edge<=6:
                    for x in range(edge,m):
                        rr,cc=(fixed,x) if horiz else (x,fixed); out[rr][cc]=2
    for r in range(H):
        if any(p[0]==r for p in pts): process(r,True, r in (r0,r1))
    for c in range(W):
        if any(p[1]==c for p in pts): process(c,False, c in (c0,c1))
    return out

for n in sorted([k for k in G if 'Demo pair' in k and 'input' in k]):
    gi,go=G[n],G[n.replace('input','output')]

    print(n,'diffs',len(diff),diff[:6])
